source.name: Sports Business Journal, 'Health care providers, financial companies dominate NFL jersey patches'
source.quote: As of Sept. 9, the Raiders and Steelers again had yet to sign a jersey sponsor for this season, and the Vikings had not replaced Pepsi's previous five-year partnership.

note: Practice-jersey patch (the only on-uniform sponsor placement the NFL allows). Start unknown, so 'from' is null. The patch was on Vikings practice jerseys at 2024 training camp (vikings.com, 2024-07-30, https://www.vikings.com/news/cam-bynum-interception-training-camp-full-pads-practice: 'The Pepsi patch sewn on Darrisaw's purple No. 71 practice jersey had some of the stitching ripped during the day's action'), and Zoomph's 2025-season guide listed 'Minnesota Vikings: Pepsi' as jersey patch partner (Wayback capture 2026-06-09, http://web.archive.org/web/20260609122038/https://zoomph.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-nfl-practice-jersey-patch-sponsors/). Zoomph's live 2026 guide lists 'Minnesota Vikings: No Partner This Season' (https://zoomph.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-nfl-practice-jersey-patch-sponsors/). PepsiCo separately extended its broader Vikings partnership through the 2031 NFL season (vikings.com, 2025-03-31, https://www.vikings.com/news/pepsi-2025-partnership-extension), but SBJ reports the jersey-patch element as a previous, five-year partnership that had not been replaced in 2026. Star Tribune (2022-01-08, via Wayback capture 2025-08-10, http://web.archive.org/web/20250810043508/https://www.startribune.com/minnesotas-pro-teams-find-new-source-of-revenue-with-ad-placement-on-uniforms/600133835) says 'Training Haus ... became the team's practice jersey partner in 2021' — the start of the Pepsi patch is unclear, and the two accounts disagree.
